text: How many cumulative laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo virus disease cases (DRC and Uganda combined) will there be since the outbreak declaration on 14 May 2026 to 31 October 2026, according to WHO?
resolution_criteria: The latest confirmed-case total in the WHO report covering on or nearest before October 31 2026. Source: WHO Ebola (DRC 2026) situation reports and Disease Outbreak News.
